what_is_wired.machine_answer: POST /api/v1/machine/answers asks the local model one question about one accepted knowledge item, whose own body is the context
what_is_wired.human_correction: POST /api/v1/machine/corrections records the model's answer and the correction together with the specific error; a machine principal is 403
what_is_wired.no_auto_promotion: the correction is an OBSERVATION with status candidate and an UNSOURCED evidence status, and the domain refuses to accept or verify machine-origin content automatically; a machine principal is also refused the review action
what_is_wired.retest_representable: a retest is a machine task carrying `retest_of`, so the link exists; no route runs one yet

what_still_needs_a_person: a real human finding a real error in a real answer, which is the step the gate is for
a human accepting the correction through POST /api/v1/knowledge-items/{id}/review-decisions
remaining: candidate generation beyond the correction itself
loop_is_closed: a model answers from accepted knowledge
a person marks a specific error and gives the correction
the correction is stored as a candidate, with the answer it corrects
the retest runs the same question and records itself with `retest_of`
promotion of the correction runs only through human review

constraints_the_domain_enforces.retest_of_a_failed_task_only: the domain refuses a retest of anything that did not fail: `retest_of must reference an existing failed machine task`. "Did the correction help" only has a meaning when something went wrong, and this was found by a test rather than assumed.
constraints_the_domain_enforces.no_self_scoring: the retest returns the prior receipt beside the new answer and states that it does not decide whether the correction helped. A Core that scored its own retest would be marking its own work.
constraints_the_domain_enforces.no_measurement_from_a_failed_run: when the model cannot answer, the route fails by name and records nothing, because a task that could not run is not a measurement.
constraints_the_domain_enforces.correction_needs_the_specific_error: `error_note` is required, because "it was wrong" is not a reviewable finding.
constraints_the_domain_enforces.a_machine_cannot_correct_or_accept: recording a correction and accepting one are both refused to a machine principal.
